the influence of the chelating agents NTA and STPP on acute toxicity of Cd and the distribution of Cd among proteins in mouse liver and kidney.
the effect of the chelating agents NTA and STPP on the acute toxicity and organ distribution pattern of cadmium in mice.

the presence of NTA or STPP during oral exposure to Cd resulted in a decreased retention and toxicity of cadmium, while during subcutaneous exposure the toxicity was increased.

the presence of chlating agents during oral or subcutaneus exposure to cadmium results in an increased toxicity and altered cadmium distribution among tissues and proteins.
